 CanMNT Talk: Attack comes alive in Concacaf qualifiers
 In the latest video blog, we look at the major takeaways from Canada's performances across the two games vs. Guatemala. 
 John Molinaro 
 Nov 17, 2026 
 — 1 min read 
 A 2026 highlighted by a historic run at the FIFA World Cup ended with an emphatic victory by the Canadian men’s team in its final match of the year. 
 Canada rolled to an easy 4-1 victory over Guatemala in the finale of their series on Monday night at BMO Field, winning the two-legged affair 7-3. In doing so, the Canadians officially qualified for the 2027 Concacaf Nations League Finals in Los Angeles in March and next summer’s Gold Cup.
 In the latest TFC Republic video blog, we look at the major takeaways from Canada's performances across the two games vs. Guatemala.
